Case built for teaching: the underlying MRI is real (public archive, cervical carcinoma before chemoradiotherapy); the endometriomas were added by computer in all sequences. The realism is good but simplified: regular shapes, no adhesions and no effect on neighboring organs. This exam lacks T1 without fat suppression: hyperintensity on T1 FS is enough to exclude fat.
Endometriomas: often bilateral and multiple; in the advanced form the ovaries adhere to each other behind the uterus ("kissing ovaries"), a sign of deep endometriosis. MRI signs: T1 and T1 FS hyperintensity, T2 shading, T2 dark spot, thick dark wall due to fibrosis and hemosiderin.
After contrast the hemorrhagic content remains hyperintense: any enhancing nodule is sought with subtraction images.
Functional hemorrhagic cyst: usually single, without marked shading, with a reticular clot, and regresses in 6-12 weeks.
In a patient with cervical carcinoma who will undergo radiotherapy, the adnexa must be described (possible ovarian transposition in young women).
Lesioni annessiali chiare in T1 FS e scu: Adnexal lesions bright on T1 FS and dark on T2 ("shading"): endometriomas; if bilateral, look for deep endometriosis.

Le metastasi sono solide o con parti sol: Metastases are solid or have enhancing solid parts; here the content is hemorrhagic.
L'idrosalpinge è tubulare, ripiegata, co: Hydrosalpinx is tubular, folded, with fluid that is bright on T2 and dark on T1.
Endometriomi ovarici bilaterali senza co: Bilateral ovarian endometriomas without solid components (O-RADS MRI 2): endometriosis, consistent with infertility and pelvic pain; also look for deep endometriosis (uterosacral ligaments, rectovaginal septum, bladder, sigmoid); refer to the gynecologists ahead of radiotherapy
Ascessi tubo-ovarici bilaterali: antibio: Bilateral tubo-ovarian abscesses: antibiotics and drainage
Gli ascessi hanno pareti spesse captanti: Abscesses have thick enhancing walls, fat edema and T2-bright content with restricted diffusion.
Il contenuto non perde segnale con la so: The content does not lose signal with fat suppression: it is blood, not fat.
Cisti follicolari semplici bilaterali, i: Bilateral simple follicular cysts, hypointense on T1 and homogeneously hyperintense on T2 like urine
Metastasi ovariche bilaterali del carcin: Bilateral ovarian metastases from the cervical carcinoma, with solid components enhancing after contrast
Idrosalpinge bilaterale: strutture tubul: Bilateral hydrosalpinx: folded tubular fluid-filled structures, hypointense on T1, separate from the ovaries
Ascessi tubo-ovarici bilaterali a parete: Bilateral thick-walled tubo-ovarian abscesses with pelvic fat oedema: intravenous antibiotics and percutaneous or surgical drainage, postponing radiotherapy
Teratomi maturi bilaterali (cisti dermoi: Bilateral mature teratomas (dermoid cysts), with fat losing signal on saturation: bilateral ovarian cystectomy before radiotherapy
Cisti emorragiche funzionali bilaterali: Bilateral functional haemorrhagic cysts that resolve spontaneously with the cycle: no follow-up, no search for deep endometriosis
